name: MCL1 apoptosis regulator, BCL2 family member

function.text: MCL1 encodes induced myeloid leukemia cell differentiation protein Mcl-1. Annotated molecular activities include channel activity and protein heterodimerization activity. It participates in cellular homeostasis and mitochondrial fusion.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Focal MCL1 amplification has been observed across multiple cancer types, including lung and breast cancers. Functional studies support an anti-apoptotic survival role in amplified tumor models; an arbitrary sequence variant is a different finding.
